list.name: run_id
list.label: Eval run
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, (llm_model || ' | run ' || id || ' | ' || to_char(run_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' | f1_avg=' || f1_avg || ' | n=' || sample_size) AS __text FROM extraction_runs ORDER BY id DESC

panels.title: Run summary
panels.description: extraction_runs — the aggregate numbers for the selected run. Per-example detail is in the table below.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  id AS run_id, run_at, llm_model, embedding_model, similarity_threshold, prompt_version,
  sample_size, precision_avg, recall_avg, f1_avg, requirement_level_accuracy_avg, unmatched_phrase_rate_avg
FROM extraction_runs
WHERE id = $run_id

panels.title: Per-example results: actual skills vs matched vs unmatched
panels.description: extraction_example_results for the selected run, worst F1 first — the full per-document breakdown: ground-truth skills (expected_skill_ids, resolved to names), skills the pipeline actually matched (predicted_skill_ids), and phrases it extracted but couldn't canonicalize (unmatched_detail, with the near-miss score). Same skill-id-to-name join pattern as the JME Extraction Review dashboard.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  e.id,
  e.example_id,
  e.source,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(s.name, ', ' ORDER BY s.name)
    FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(e.expected_skill_ids) sid
    JOIN skills s ON s.id = sid::int
  ), '') AS actual_skills,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(s.name, ', ' ORDER BY s.name)
    FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(e.predicted_skill_ids) sid
    JOIN skills s ON s.id = sid::int
  ), '') AS matched_skills,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg((u->>'phrase') || ' (score ' || COALESCE(u->>'best_score', 'n/a') || ')', ', ')
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.unmatched_detail) u
  ), '') AS unmatched_phrases,
  e.precision,
  e.recall,
  e.f1,
  e.requirement_level_accuracy
FROM extraction_example_results e
WHERE e.run_id = $run_id
ORDER BY e.f1 ASC
LIMIT 500
